# ymfm

This directory contains the YM3812-relevant subset of
[aaronsgiles/ymfm](https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm), pinned from commit
`81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a`.

The upstream code is licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License. See `LICENSE`.
Only the common FM, OPL, ADPCM, and PCM source dependencies required to build
the YM3812 implementation are included.
